title: Cory Mills Loses Republican Primary Amid Assault Allegations and Ethics Investigation
summary: Mr. Mills, who is under investigation by the House Ethics Committee and has faced allegations of assault and threatening behavior toward women, lost to Ryan Elijah, a former TV news anchor.
